source_evidence.frozen_requirement_text: Food wastes shall be comminuted or ground and shall be capable of passing through a screen with openings no greater than 25 mm. Food wastes shall not be contaminated by any other garbage type.

contract.comparisonModel: IF food_waste_discharge_to_sea = true, THEN food_waste_comminuted_or_ground = true, required_screen_opening_mm <= 25, and contaminated_by_other_garbage = false.
